body.statement: For every \(Q\in\mathcal P_{\mathrm{full}}\), the Hölder versions are unique on the positive anchor neighborhood and \(\tau_Q^{\mathrm c}(x_0)=\tau_Q(x_0)=\mu_{1,Q}(x_0)-\mu_{0,Q}(x_0)\).
body.justification: The target must be a point-identified causal contrast rather than an arbitrary version of an almost-everywhere conditional mean.
body.gap: KennedyBalakrishnanRobinsWasserman2024 uses the observed CATE regression; this lemma records the causal-version equality at the anchor under the present full-data model.
body.consumer: Applied users can interpret coverage of \(C_n(h,k)\) as coverage of the causal CATE at the prespecified covariate profile \(x_0\).
